raw_blocks: Strength is more than muscle and brawn; real strength is character, conviction and grit. It’s a core belief that binds us together with our customers, employees and communities. It’s a promise to do what’s right—good people helping good people.

At The Monarch Cement Company, that strength has forged a solid foundation for more than a century. It holds us to a higher standard of quality. It reinforces our commitment to our customers throughout the Midwest. It paves a path to innovation, to use technology for smarter, more efficient results that are also good for the planet.
Quietly driven and fiercely independent, that strength is the hidden ingredient that still binds us more than 100 years later as we honor the past while building a stronger future.
A family atmosphere, a commitment to the local community, even an on-site medical clinic—Monarch believes the priority should always be our people.
Roots run deep at Monarch, and the Company story is one of integrity, quality and extraordinary people whose pride shows in every detail.

raw_blocks: As the world’s most widely used construction material and one of the planet’s most-consumed resources, cement forms the backbone of our modern civilization. It’s the hidden ingredient giving strength to the concrete and mortar that form our buildings, roads and everything in between.
At The Monarch Cement Company, we’re proud to produce consistent and high-quality Portland and masonry cements to serve our region.
Monarch is proud to offer Portland-Limestone Cement (PLC) – engineered to reduce carbon emissions by approximately 10% but with all the performance and resilience you’ve come to expect.
One of the most versatile construction products, Portland cement is the most common type of cement and serves as the basic component of concrete, mortar, stucco and non-specialty grout.
Used in brick, block and stone masonry construction, masonry cement produced by Monarch serves as a key element of the building industry throughout the Midwest.
